name: @epoch/extension-runtime
description: Epoch Extension Runtime kernel — the sandboxed HOST machinery model for capability-scoped extension hosting (W008): admission with digest verification and capability-registry binding resolution, permission enforcement at the boundary (grant checks on every host call, typed denials with precise paths), typed invocation envelopes, in-memory reference host state, and deterministic execution-surface descriptions. No persistence, no UI, no workflow engine.
